Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unfounded directive to “confirm pneumonia as the immediate cause” and to “default to pneumonia” if sources only stated “complications of Huntington’s disease.” This biased the investigation away from the correct cause (Huntington’s disease) and could produce the wrong final answer, despite credible sources attributing Guthrie’s death to Huntington’s disease (or its complications).
